title: Who is Jensen Huang? Nvidia chief under scrutiny over affair and spying reports
summary: Nvidia's board is meeting to decide whether to oust CEO Jensen Huang, as the AI chip giant grapples with reports of two extramarital affairs involving its longtime leader. Huang's future is now in the balance at the company he co-founded and helped transform into a global AI powerhouse. We look back at his rise and his journey to becoming one of the most in…
